integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard elementary determinantal geometry. The standalone checker is a finite corroboration only; no independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: For Heisenberg rank at least two in characteristic two, the conclusion describes the reduced variety, not the full possibly nonreduced scheme.
Homomorphisms are labelled and the target is the trace-zero two-by-two Lie algebra, not general matrices.
Odd-characteristic commuting-variety geometry is prior work, not newly claimed.
The small characteristic-two faithful representation was already known.
Publication-priority completeness and independent mathematical validation are not established.
title: Characteristic-two Heisenberg-to-traceless-two-matrix homomorphism varieties and image-rank spectra
